acceptanceCriteria.subject: delegated planning basis and exact reservation identity
passWhenAll: all four required owner-delegated planning selections remain hash-bound
every exact reservation reference retains its source path, JSON pointer, cell count, bounds, and coordinate-set SHA-256

acceptanceCriteria.subject: bounded current-snapshot geometry checks
passWhenAll: bounded checks remain true against the source-bound immutable region evidence
PASS is represented only as geometry/collision evidence, never structural, code, route, or commissioning acceptance

acceptanceCriteria.subject: B07 west-two hydrology, lining, transfer, ownership, and technical design
passWhenAll: all 38 water cells and the waterlogged state have an exact source-to-future disposition with no undeclared diversion
lining, support, observation-refuge transfer, stair/lift, smoke, drainage, owners, and both endpoint interfaces are exact and technically accepted
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: Structure-bound clearance passes, but 38 current water cells and every technical mechanism remain unresolved.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: two independent protected stair and accessible-lift routes
passWhenAll: each occupied-space-to-exterior stair route is continuous, exact, independently owned, fail-safe, and technically accepted
each reserved accessible-lift route has an exact mechanism, refuge/transfer treatment, emergency operation, power, controls, ownership, and independent technical acceptance
both routes remain independent under each declared single failure and have frozen commissioning tests
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: The packet binds exact reservations and caps only; no complete stair, lift, or accessible route is commissioned.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: smoke compartments and four local vent risers
passWhenAll: smoke design criteria, scenarios, control zones, flow direction, outlet separation, failure states, and acceptance thresholds are authored and independently accepted
every duct, fan/control mechanism, cap transition, exterior outlet, owner, interface, power source, and commissioning test is exact and hash-bound
the four presently capped risers remain sealed until all criteria pass
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: Four dry, structure-clear riser reservations pass geometry review, but no outlet, smoke model, mechanism, or commissioning exists.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: platform barriers and smoke-opening mechanisms
passWhenAll: all barrier and smoke-door mechanism cells, controls, manual release, train-door alignment, failure state, owner, interface, and test criteria are exact and independently accepted
static caps remain in the source/future contract until the complete mechanisms pass
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: The exact 192 platform-gate and 72 smoke-opening cap cells are fail-closed reservations, not working systems.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: normal and redundant emergency lighting/power circuits
passWhenAll: normal and two independent emergency circuit cellsets, sources, controls, transfer/failure behavior, owners, interfaces, and commissioning tests are exact and independently accepted
the 56 fixture reservations pass an accepted coverage/visibility criterion under normal and every declared emergency state
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: Fixture points are exact, but circuit paths, sources, redundancy, performance, and commissioning evidence do not exist.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: eight capped local drainage interfaces
passWhenAll: inflow, storage, freeboard, duration, failure, recovery, no-diversion, and future-fluid criteria are exact and accepted
each sump/channel, pump/control if any, retained header, external discharge if any, owner, interface, and failure test is exact and independently accepted
D05 accepts any external receiver/discharge ownership before a boundary cap may open
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: Eight three-cell local caps remain sealed; no hydraulic model, pump, receiver, or external discharge is accepted.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: fire/service access and exterior approach
passWhenAll: an exact external approach route, usable access criterion, surface compound, internal transfer, owner, interfaces, controls, and failure states are accepted

the spine and surface caps remain sealed until all criteria pass
acceptanceCriteria.holdReason: EG-B is selected only as the minimum-geometry review interface; the external route is null and all interfaces remain closed.

acceptanceCriteria.subject: canonical owners and exact cross-scope interface contracts
passWhenAll: every construction, interaction, mechanism, control, utility, route, cap, outlet, and future-state cell has exactly one canonical owner
every cross-owner seam has an exact, directioned, hash-bound interface contract and the global interface audit passes with zero undeclared seams
